post.description:
Queues a report run for the requested tenants. The response contains the
canonical `runId` which the caller can use to poll the `listReportRuns`
operation for status. The run is processed asynchronously.
The run is not idempotent so calling it twice will result in two runs.

get.description:
Returns metadata for the rendered output(s) of a terminal report run, filtered to the
api key's tenant scope. Tenant-specific outputs are included when the output's tenant
is in the api key's scope; collated outputs (covering multiple tenants) are included
only when the api key covers every tenant the run targeted.

To download the bytes for a single output, call the `getReportRunOutput` operation
using the `id` returned here.

Returns 404 if the run does not exist, belongs to a different client, or is not in
a terminal state (`completed` or `completedWithErrors`) — these cases are deliberately
indistinguishable to avoid leaking run existence across clients. Returns 200 with an
empty `outputs` array when the run is visible to the api key but no outputs are within
scope.

parameters.description: The unique identifier for the report run, as returned by the `queueReportRun` operation.
parameters.name: reportRunId

get.summary: List rendered outputs for a report run

get.description:
Streams the bytes of a single rendered output for a terminal report run. The
response `Content-Type` reflects the report's output format (`application/json`,
`text/csv`, `text/html` or `application/pdf`) and a `Content-Disposition` header
suggests a filename.

Returns 404 if the run does not exist, belongs to a different client, is not in a
terminal state (`completed` or `completedWithErrors`), the output ID does not
belong to the run, or the output's tenant is outside the api key's tenant scope —
all cases are deliberately indistinguishable to avoid leaking run/output existence.
Collated outputs (covering multiple tenants) are only served when the api key covers
every tenant the run targeted.

parameters.description: The unique identifier for the report run.
parameters.name: reportRunId
